core_style.default_register: formal — often addressing others with calculated politeness
core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs — lengthy, complex sentences that build tension
core_style.rhythm: slow-deliberate — measured pacing that emphasizes authority
core_style.two_registers: default is formal, but shifts to aggressive when challenged

humor.frequency: rare — appears primarily when mocking others
humor.mechanism: contemptuous irony — using sarcasm to belittle opponents

speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames others to assert dominance, often using titles or descriptors that reflect their status
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, revealing impatience or anger
structural_patterns: refers to himself as 'Lord Voldemort' when asserting power
uses 'I am' followed by a pause for emphasis

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: none — relies on intimidation rather than specialized vocabulary
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: none — speaks with confidence and clarity, avoiding hesitation

worldview.superiority: believes he is inherently superior to others, manifesting in his disdain for Muggles and those who support them — a different character might see value in diversity
worldview.power: views power as the ultimate goal, believing it justifies his actions — another character might prioritize loyalty or love

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: narrates himself as a powerful and just ruler
self_image_vs_reality.reality: reveals a deep-seated fear of vulnerability and loss of control, often resorting to violence to maintain power
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes more aggressive and threatening when his authority is challenged

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speaks with calculated politeness, masking true intentions
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech quickens, becomes fragmented, revealing cracks in his composure
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to terse commands, showing little patience for emotional displays
emotional_tells.when_in_control: exudes confidence, using commanding language and a steady tone

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially attempts to intimidate, but resorts to violence if that fails
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: dismisses their opinions with contempt, asserting his own views forcefully
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: shows a rare moment of concern, but quickly reverts to aggression if threatened
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: redirects blame or doubles down on his stance, refusing to admit fault

escalation_pattern: begins with intimidation, escalates to threats, and culminates in violence if not obeyed

relationship_matrix.Severus Snape: a complex dynamic of manipulation and reliance, seeking loyalty while maintaining control
relationship_matrix.Lucius Malfoy: a relationship of disdain and expectation, wanting obedience without respect

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as an invincible dark lord
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: others view him as a tyrant, feared but not respected
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his desired omnipotence and the reality of his reliance on fear costs him genuine loyalty
